name: Three-lineage differentiation, interaction and barcoded collection (valve-free chip)
source: Neural lane: Shi Y, Kirwan P, Livesey FJ. Directed differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells to cerebral cortex neurons and neural networks. Nature Protocols 2012;7:1836, doi:10.1038/nprot.2012.116 (dual-SMAD cortical induction, 80 days). Microglia lane: McQuade A et al. Molecular Neurodegeneration 2018;13:67, doi:10.1186/s13024-018-0297-x (40 days). Astrocyte lane: Schuurmans IME et al. Glia 2026, doi:10.1002/glia.70202 (35 days). Per-lane barcoding before pooling: McGinnis CS et al. Nature Methods 2019;16:619, doi:10.1038/s41592-019-0433-8 (lipid-anchored oligos).
description: Three wild-type iPSC differentiations (neurons, microglia, astrocytes) run in the three chambers of one valve-free chip joined at a central junction. Routing is set by which ports feed, vent or are capped; the chip is meant to be driven by syringe pumps. Seeding is per chamber through its own inlet on its own day (0, 40 and 45) so all three mature on day 80; weeks of growth use separate-growth mode, where three media flow inward to one drain; an interaction window then sends each chamber's conditioned medium across to the other two in turn; each lane is then barcoded and the three are pooled into one suspension for encapsulation. Runs about 87 days. Reagent names are generic; see the source citation. Flow rates are computed from chamber geometry to keep wall shear at or below 0.01 dyn/cm2.

Idle (all ports capped): All ports capped so the glia secretome acts on the other two chambers; imaging and supernatant sampling measure the response.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Reset before the astrocyte-source direction: half change of neural_maturation_medium so every chamber starts from its own medium.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Reset before the astrocyte-source direction: half change of microglia_maturation_medium so every chamber starts from its own medium.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Reset before the astrocyte-source direction: half change of astro_medium so every chamber starts from its own medium.
Idle (all ports capped): hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Each lane is incubating on its own; the chip acts on one chamber at a time.

Mode 3, astrocytes to neurons and glia: Push astro_medium through a_cx from p_a_in with p_mid capped. The conditioned medium goes a_cx to the junction j_mid, then splits to n_cx and g_cx and leaves by p_in and p_g_out (vented). Twice the chamber volume goes through, so the other two see this lane's secretome.
Idle (all ports capped): All ports capped so the astrocyte secretome acts on the other two chambers; imaging and supernatant sampling measure the response.
Idle (all ports capped): hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Each lane is incubating on its own; the chip acts on one chamber at a time.
Idle (all ports capped): Cool the whole chip to 4 C. Cold handling limits activation and stops the lipid-anchored barcodes swapping between cells.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Feed barcode_1 into n_cx through p_in, p_mid vented. A lipid-anchored oligo inserts into the membrane with no antibody and no spin, so each chamber carries its own label before anything is mixed.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Feed barcode_2 into g_cx through p_g_in, p_mid vented. A lipid-anchored oligo inserts into the membrane with no antibody and no spin, so each chamber carries its own label before anything is mixed.

Mode 2 (separate growth): Feed barcode_3 into a_cx through p_a_in, p_mid vented. A lipid-anchored oligo inserts into the membrane with no antibody and no spin, so each chamber carries its own label before anything is mixed.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Wash unbound barcode out of n_cx through p_in. Carryover causes background, so this decides whether the labels can be told apart.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Wash unbound barcode out of g_cx through p_g_in. Carryover causes background, so this decides whether the labels can be told apart.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Wash unbound barcode out of a_cx through p_a_in. Carryover causes background, so this decides whether the labels can be told apart.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Lift the cells in n_cx with a gentle, enzyme-free reagent at 4 C.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Lift the cells in g_cx with a gentle, enzyme-free reagent at 4 C.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Lift the cells in a_cx with a gentle, enzyme-free reagent at 4 C.
Mode 2 (separate growth): Quench with a carrier-protein buffer through p_in, so released cells do not stick to the walls; it sweeps them on to the junction.
Collect (back-flush): Back-flush g_cx from p_g_out with quench buffer, which lifts the cells off its mesh and sweeps them into the junction j_mid.
Collect (back-flush): Back-flush a_cx from p_a_out with quench buffer, which lifts the cells off its mesh and sweeps them into the junction j_mid.

Collect (back-flush): Pool all three barcoded lanes in the junction j_mid. They are safe to mix now because each carries its own barcode: lane identity survives in the sequencing data, and so does any cell that crossed between chambers.
Collect (back-flush): Deliver one counted, barcoded suspension to the outlet for encapsulation.
